methodology.purpose: Evidence-based weekly SEO/AEO opportunity queue using existing dashboard datasets.
principles: No fabricated or interpolated search observations.
Booking starts are not confirmed bookings.
AI referrals do not measure no-click AI answers.
SEO event timing is context, not proof of causation.

actions.subject: tampa bay cleaning services
actions.why_flagged: The existing deterministic GSC Action Center classified this as Visibility decline.

evidence.gsc_evidence: Impressions fell from 59 to 24 (-35, 59% decline); position change -5.77. Current landing page: https://tampabayshine.com/.

conversion_context.note: GA4 Organic Search landing-page evidence for the ranking URL. Event counts are not unique-user probabilities.

actions.recommended_action: Inspect the query and landing-page history before changing content. Determine whether the loss reflects ranking decline, reduced search demand, indexing/canonical changes, or Google selecting a different URL.

measurement.30_days: Recheck impressions, clicks, CTR, and average position for tampa bay cleaning services. Confirm that Google is still selecting the intended landing page.
measurement.60_days: Compare the next 28-day period with the prior period. Review Organic Search landing-page sessions and booking-start intent without treating a small sample as proof of causation.
measurement.90_days: Evaluate sustained search visibility plus Organic Search booking starts and confirmed bookings. Keep, refine, or reverse the change based on the combined evidence.
